facets.F1_correctness: UploadIntent, DownloadIntent, and DriveSearchQuery now require CellId beside TenantId before storage/search adapters can execute.
facets.F2_tests: Buck2 unit tests assert tenant and cell scope on storage upload/download intents and drive search queries.
facets.F3_maintainability: The change stays in the provider-neutral office kernel crates and avoids provider SDK, database, object-store, search-engine, shell, or CLI coupling.
facets.F4_compatibility: Only kernel constructors for request-bound storage/search intents change; rg found no production callers outside the updated crate tests.
facets.F5_security: No credentials, unsafe Rust, network calls, new privileges, or policy widening are introduced.
facets.F6_privacy: No document body or user content handling is added. CellId is routing/isolation metadata already modeled in oya-office-kernel.
facets.F7_operability: Adapters can emit and enforce tenant plus cell boundaries without deriving cell scope from storage keys, index aliases, or provider-specific metadata.
facets.F8_performance: No runtime loop, allocation-heavy path, or dependency is added beyond carrying an existing value object in intent structs.
facets.F9_compliance: No hand-edited *.generated.json files and no new dependencies. The evidence artifact follows the existing multispectrum shape used in this checkout.
facets.F10_reversibility: Rollback is a normal git revert of two Rust kernel files and this append-only evidence file; no data migration or production state mutation is introduced.
facets.F11_observability: Request-bound storage and search contracts now expose stable tenant_id and cell_id fields for future audit, metrics, and SLO dimensions.
facets.F13_migration: Moves office storage/search toward owned-stack migration by making the adapter boundary cell-aware before any provider-specific backend is introduced.
facets.M1_challenge_assumption: Rejected provider-derived cell inference; the kernel should carry explicit routing scope instead of trusting object-store keys or search index naming conventions.
facets.M2_zoomed_out_fit: This closes a narrow hyperscaler parity gap inside owned office paths without touching shared hot files, generated faces, or cross-domain contracts.
